method: Transparent heuristic. Race order is 5K, 10K, 1/2M, marathon, 50K, 100K. Fitness estimates blend threshold pace proxy with observed activity equivalents. Trend compares current performance with activity-derived equivalents from roughly three months ago. Readiness is separately gated by longest recent run and 28-day volume.
